items.mainDefect: Backup code consumption is a non-atomic read-modify-write, so concurrent logins can reuse the same single-use backup code.

secondary.defect: Used backup codes are set to null and never filtered out, so once every code is used the array is all nulls and the MissingBackupCodes error is never returned.

items.mainDefect: In the login path, backup codes are checked with indexOf/===, which is not constant-time and leaks timing information an attacker could use to enumerate codes.

secondary.defect: Backup code comparison does not normalize hex case, so codes typed in a different case fail to match.

items.mainDefect: In the disable endpoint, backup codes are checked with indexOf/===, which is not constant-time and creates a timing oracle.

secondary.defect: Backup codes are not converted to lower case before comparison, so uppercase input is rejected.
